messages:
incident-bot: PAGE | Severity: P1 | hosted-api inference error spike (>8xx) in us-west-2. Gateway returning 502s. Paging oncall: @alice. Incident channel created #inc-1795001234

alice: I'm oncall — looking at logs and current rollout. Will post updates here. Starting with checking canary traffic routing.

raj: seeing a big jump in upstream 502s from model-serving nodes. Canary rollout v2.3.5 started 10:11 UTC, traffic ~10%. Correlates with 5xx spike across length.

maria: customer-impact quick note: ~12 tenants affected, highest failure rate for acme-corp (approx 5% fail). Raising priority for SRE/customer-ops to notify top customers.

jordan: recommend immediate routing fallback to stable-model v2.3.4 and hold new rollouts until root cause identified. Also enable prefix-KV caching bypass for affected routes to reduce timeouts.

alice: rolling canary back to v2.3.4 now (rolling restart with graceful drain). Command:
```
redwood deploy rollback --model stable:v2.3.4 --region us-west-2 --graceful
```
Progress: 0% -> 40% -> 100%.

incident-bot: ACTION: rollback triggered by alice at 2026-03-15T10:18:40Z. Monitoring metrics.

sam: logs show timeout spikes on kvcache layer during v2.3.5 runtime init. sample tail:
```
2026-03-15T10:12:33Z error runtime: kvcache miss -> refresh timeout (2000ms)
2026-03-15T10:12:34Z warn grpc: upstream 502 broken pipe conn=xyz
2026-03-15T10:12:36Z info routing: fallback triggered for route /v1/generate
```

alice: errors dropping back to baseline after rollback. Customer impact reduced. Preparing post-incident plan.

kate: PM note — we need a postmortem and action items. Proposed attendees: eng-runtime, eng-ml (model onboards), eng-sre, product, customer-ops, and one primary contact from top affected tenant (acme-corp). Suggested slots: tomorrow 16:00 or 17:00 UTC. Who can prep RCA draft?

raj: I can take the RCA draft, will include timeline, telemetry, and suspected KV cache race. Need logs and kernel traces from model nodes.

bryan: I'll handle customer comms draft and coordinate with account lead for acme-corp.

sam: creating tickets on incident board now.

sam: tickets created: INC-4132 (root-cause RCA), INC-4133 (improve rollout gating), INC-4134 (kvcache timeout hardening). Putting priority P0/P1 as appropriate.

alice: action items (owners / sizing / quarter tie-in):
1) Deep RCA and retro (raj) — size: L (3w, includes traces & repro) — quarter: Q2 OKR: "Reliable rollouts"
2) Rollout gating: add extra preflight checks + automated rollback thresholds (eng-release) — owner: sam — size: M (1w) — quarter: Q2
3) KV cache resilience: increase timeout, add jitter and better backoff (eng-runtime) — owner: raj — size: M (1.5w) — quarter: Q2
4) Customer comms and SLA follow-up (bryan) — size: S (2d) — quarter: Customer Success ops
5) Postmortem doc & action tracking (kate) — size: S (3d) — quarter: process improvements

kate: prioritization rationale: items 1-3 labeled Severity-P1 follow-ups -> must be in next two sprints. Items 4-5 are high-priority but lower engineering effort. We'll map these to quarterly priorities and raise the rollout gating ticket to Q2 priority.

alice: scheduling postmortem: tentative slot confirmed 2026-03-16T17:00 UTC. Invite will go out to list above. Please add any additional owners to the tickets.

maria: adding customer impact notes to incident timeline and will ping acme-corp account lead for follow-up.

bryan: will send comms + mitigation summary after postmortem, estimated send in 48h.

oncall-bot: oncall handoff reminder: Alice will hand off to Jordan in 2h for follow-up monitoring.

alice: thanks everyone. I'll close the live mitigation thread when metrics are stable for 1h. Leaving follow-ups in INC-4132..4134.

sam: noted, closing live page. Next: sync on action items during weekly reliability meeting.

kate: assigning owners in tracker and will add sizing estimates to Jira tasks. Closing notes: severity=P1 -> schedule delivery targets into sprint planning.
